## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and angular woman with a gaunt figure, sallow cheeks, and hard, work-worn hands. Even as a child, she was considered a dark and homely little thing. Over the years, she has grown somewhat thinner and even more angular, with her dark hair taking on more gray streaks while remaining tightly twisted into a hard little knot.

## Personality

A self-contained and sensible woman, she possesses a rigid conscience and is strictly devoted to performing her duty. She is practical, non-imaginative, and prefers neatness and order, often taking a cautious and deliberate approach when making decisions. Though stern, repressed, and sometimes unsympathetic or sarcastic, she has nevertheless mellowed over time and worries a lot about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). She is firmly opposed to imagining things differently from reality, detests cats, and refuses on principle to criticize ministers in any form. Her character is marked by an inexorable approach to discipline and a fondness for tacking morals onto her remarks. Additionally, she holds a strong motivation to drill [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into a tranquil uniformity of disposition, while secretly hoping in her heart that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## History

Marilla Cuthbert raised herself at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) according to traditional childhood discipline, having grown up under the sting of being called a dark, homely child by an aunt, and she never forgave her youthful suitor John Blythe after a quarrel. Sixty years into her life at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Marilla sent her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to fetch an orphan boy to work the farm, only for him to bring back an imaginative girl named [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Initial shock turned to pity as Marilla learned of Anne's past, prompting her to adopt the child and endeavor to raise her properly. Over the years, Marilla found herself deeply attached to the girl, standing by her through household mishaps and scholastic achievements. Following Matthew's sudden death from heart failure and her own impending blindness, Marilla was spared selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chose to forgo a college scholarship to stay and teach locally. Marilla later invited the widowed [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), enabling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while Marilla took in two orphaned relatives, the Keith twins. She continued to manage the household and offer steady counsel as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) navigated college, local gossip, and growing up.

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Although Marilla initially intended to adopt a boy to help on the farm, she allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after learning she might otherwise be placed with a harsh employer. As her adoptive mother and dear friend, Marilla takes charge of educating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), instructing her in household chores and bedtime prayers while learning to love the imaginative girl. Over time, their bond deepens into a cherished companionship, and they support each other through deep personal grief.

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Marilla and [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) are long-time neighbors and tea companions who frequently share local news and travel together, such as taking a trip to a political mass meeting. Though [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) can be blunt and quick to judge, Marilla trusts her judgment and often seeks her advice when deciding how to handle Anne's upbringing.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla serves as a guardian to [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) after bringing him and his twin sister home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She actively commands and disciplines [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through his frequent misbehavior, such as hiding toads in her bed or stealing jam. Despite the constant trouble his mischievous nature causes, Marilla feels a warm affection for him and recognizes that he needs her guidance.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +11 more_
